create_tiled_linear: create a plain tiled linear layer mapping multiple named inputs to multiple named outputs
create_sparse_tiled_linear: create a sparse tiled linear layer with fixed connectivity patterns and sparsity ratios
create_layer_normed_tiled_linear: create a tiled linear layer with layer normalization applied per input
create_overlaid_tiled_linear: create a tiled linear layer with weight sharing and low-rank overlays
build_tiled_linear: build a tiled linear module with input name-size pairs and output name-size pairs
